headline: Clean again (6 uploads, 29 runs, 0 failures) and the judge closed cta (score) and cry (modern), so the hints test is now live; captions-tie still needs your call and analytics only reach Nov 15.
happened: Wed Nov 18 (UTC, since yesterday's brief): 3 single Shorts (Bug-type Ep. 79, Water-type, Fire-type Ep. 81) and 3 rapid-fires (Generation 1 at 41 s, Legendary at 43 s, a 7-sound Generation 4 at 55 s). All public on YouTube and cross-posted to Instagram and Facebook. 29 workflow runs, all green; Run failures is empty.

Judge, Nov 18: cta decided as score (74.7 vs 73.3 on pack-adjusted % viewed, n=9/10, a 2 % lead called 'close enough'); cry decided as modern (og led 73.4 vs 71.8, n=16/20, a 2 % lead, incumbent kept). The active test is now hints, with no scored videos yet.

Analytics ran Nov 18 at 15:56 UTC and now reach Nov 15: 3,966 views and +8/-1 subscribers that day; Nov 9-15 total 21,672 views. Channel: 55 subscribers (unchanged), 60,055 views (was 56,614), 161 videos (was 156). The nightly job has not run yet today.

Views on the 3 Shorts from Nov 18 are still tiny (Bug Ep. 79: 40 at the last pull; the other two are not in the dashboard list yet), so treat them as unknown, not weak. Nov 17 singles: Psychic 815, Electric 231; rapid-fires: Then & Now 591, Gen 4 866, Mix 265, Dragon 12.
No new commits on main since the Nov 18 judgement commit. PR #8 (new formats) is still open.

decisions.title: Reopen the captions decision? It was a tie on retention and static reaches 34 % fewer viewers.
decisions.why: The judge crowned static at the sample cap on a 3 % lead (bar is 10 %) and bypassed the views guard. The rule is fixed for future tests; this one needs a human call.
options: Reopen and keep kinetic as baseline (incumbent on a tie)
Leave static; carry kinetic's gold highlight and chunked Pokédex into static as a new test
decisions.recommendation: Reopen and keep kinetic as baseline (incumbent on a tie)
decisions.how: Reply in chat; it's a one-line edit to state/experiments.json.

ideas: Themes at the 0.4 fitness floor still get Shorts slots (Starter n=4, median 98 views; Water n=2, 83; Generation 1 n=3, 41) while Dragon (median 784) and Psychic (682.5) sit at 2.2+; a week without the floor themes in Shorts would show whether those slots do better on the strong ones.
The same weak themes do better as rapid-fires than as single Shorts (Generation 1 rapid median 229 vs 41; Generation 2 675 vs 153.5; Starter 148 vs 98), so rapid may be the better home for them.
watch: PR #8 (Pokémon-or-medicine, slowed cries, Pokédex-first test, format registry): open since Nov 17, still waiting on your preview check.
cta and cry were both called on 2 % leads, well under the 10 % bar. cta crowned the leader; cry kept the incumbent. If you want ties to always hold the incumbent, cta is the one that differs.

Open comparisons, all early: series numbered 79.7 (n=9) vs plain 70.0 (n=5); ladder dots 74.0 (n=11) vs chip 74.2 (n=3); rapidtail spoken 63.8 (n=7) vs loop 62.3 (n=7), though loop gains more subscribers per video (1.14 vs 0.14). rapidlen has no scored videos yet and rapidvoice has one.
Platforms: Instagram 132 followers and 136,117 views; Facebook shows 0 followers, 3 views and 0 reach across 156 posts, so the Facebook cross-post is reaching nobody.
ElevenLabs balance could not be read (the API call timed out), so no figure today. YPP: 55 / 1,000 subscribers, 4.8 / 4,000 watch hours, 35,281 Shorts views in 90 days vs the 10,000,000 bar.
